name: broadbanner-post-production
description: Production+ post-production for BroadBanner creators (post_production_distribution add-on). Turn a finished Substack live draft into a review: file it under its series section, capture and store the transcript, correct it against the live roster, generate the review from the show's editorial config, and push it as an editable DRAFT to the member portal. The operator supplies only the draft URL and series name; everything else comes from the BroadBanner MCP connector.
